prompt: Create one polished desktop application icon for Norvi Office, a professional document and spreadsheet suite. Use lavender #b49af4 and pale off-white #f2eff8 only for the emblem, with deep muted purple in its folded facets. Place it centered on a completely uniform matte charcoal #272727 background. The emblem occupies 74 percent of the square with even margins. Premium contemporary productivity software branding, calm and precise, consistent with a charcoal and lavender glass desktop theme. Icon asset only, square composition, crisp smooth edges. No text, wordmark, captions, dots, loading indicator, Microsoft branding, multicolor tiles, extra objects, decorative backdrop or mockup.
